description: Return ONE signed, dated Monte Carlo distribution. use it rather than `assess_market_regime` for monte carlo, not market regime; an object with 32 fields including as_of, canonicalization. $0.15 USDC.

as_of.description: The date the answer is computed as of (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today. Use it to reproduce a past answer exactly.
as_of.title: As Of

runs.description: The runs this operation operates on. See the schema for its type and whether it is required.
runs.title: Runs

seed.description: The random seed, so a stochastic answer can be reproduced exactly.
seed.title: Seed

trade_distribution.description: The trade distribution this operation operates on. See the schema for its type and whether it is required.
trade_distribution.title: Trade Distribution

trades.description: The trades this operation operates on. See the schema for its type and whether it is required.
trades.title: Trades

name: run_monte_carlo

as_of.description: The date the answer is computed as of.

canonicalization.description: The canonicalisation rule the digest was computed under.

evidence_core.description: The canonical, signed core of the answer — the payload the signature covers.

methodology_version.description: Version of the method that produced the answer.

output_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical evidence core.

signature.description: The Ed25519 signature over the evidence core, base64-encoded.

signed_by.description: The key id that signed the answer.

title: Run Monte Carlo
